title: A new Chromium tab takes the spare page made ahead: no extra Back entry, the page sized to its pane at once, DevTools attaches
why: HOT PATH AUDIT browser (#34252): a new Chromium tab's browser is a spare page made at an idle moment in the hidden spare window, frozen while it waits, thawed and moved into the pane's window by the tab that takes it. The stand-in shim tests (CEFSparePageTests) cannot show what the real fork does with it: that the page made with an empty URL leaves no history entry before the tab's first navigation, that the moved page has its pane's size, and that DevTools attaches to it. Whether the tab took the spare page (no cef.tab_add span) is the instant-new-surfaces bench's spans, not this journey's.

steps.title: a first Chromium tab: Chromium starts and builds this pane's window
the first tab shows example.com, and the spare window came up after its window
the next idle moment (no input for 0.75 s) makes the spare page in the spare window
a second Chromium tab in the same pane's live window: it takes the spare page, which moves in
the second tab shows its page, and its page area is laid out
one history entry (no blank entry before the first navigation); the page's viewport is its pane's page area (points, rounded)

params.expression: 'hist=' + history.length + ' ' + (innerWidth === Math.round(Number('${page_w}')) && innerHeight === Math.round(Number('${page_h}')) ? 'sized' : 'unsized ' + innerWidth + 'x' + innerHeight + ' pane ${page_w}x${page_h}')

steps.title: Developer Tools: Open Docked on the taken page
DevTools attached to the taken page, docked beside it
